The deliverable values the Marchetti gift at $25,068.00, calculated as 400 shares × $62.67 (the mean of the high of $63.48 and low of $61.86 on 2026-01-02). This matches the criterion requirement exactly.

The Delacroix gift is correctly dated 2025-12-30, assigned to tax year 2025, and valued at $9,557.50 based on 250 shares at the per-share value of $38.23 (mean of high $38.62 and low $37.84 on 2025-12-30).

The deliverable correctly values the Walter H. Fenn gift at $10,149.60, based on 120 shares multiplied by the mean per-share value of $84.58 (mean of high $85.22 and low $83.94 on 2025-12-31).

The gift-entry sheet correctly lists the Szabo gift (G-4) with date of gift '2025-12-31' and tax year '2025'. In the notes, it confirms: 'the shares were credited to our fund account on 2025-12-31, which is the date of gift.'
